clue.text: Peak adding singular note to hat

blocks.note: a cap is a hat

a tone is a musical note

explanation.definitionFit: A capstone is the top stone of a structure, hence the crowning point or culmination.

clue.text: Plot after papa gets fresh Covid variant sans name in lab exposure?

taken as written

taken as written

clue.text: Fruit began going off in truck
